#!/bin/bash
# Boot Windows 3.11 for Workgroups under QEMU and leave it running at the desktop.
#
#  * base image /app/isos/win311.img stays immutable (-snapshot)
#  * VNC server on display :1  -> TCP 5901
#  * QEMU monitor socket /tmp/qemu-monitor.sock (programmatic keyboard input)
#  * QMP socket on 127.0.0.1:4444 (secondary control interface)
set -u

IMG=/app/isos/win311.img
MON=/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock
PIDFILE=/tmp/qemu-win311.pid
SCRIPTS=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
MAXTRY=${MAXTRY:-8}

qemu_stop() {
  if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
    kill "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null
    sleep 2
    kill -9 "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
  fi
  rm -f "$MON"
}

qemu_start() {
  qemu-system-i386 \
    -machine pc \
    -cpu pentium \
    -m 32 \
    -drive file="$IMG",format=raw,if=ide,index=0,media=disk,snapshot=on \
    -vga cirrus \
    -netdev user,id=net0 -device ne2k_pci,netdev=net0 \
    -rtc base=localtime \
    -boot c \
    -k en-us \
    -icount shift=6,sleep=on \
    -vnc 0.0.0.0:1 \
    -monitor unix:"$MON",server,nowait \
    -qmp tcp:127.0.0.1:4444,server,nowait \
    -no-shutdown \
    -name win311 \
    -pidfile "$PIDFILE" \
    -daemonize
}

screen() { "$SCRIPTS/screen.py" "$@" 2>/dev/null; }
keys() { "$SCRIPTS/qkey.py" key "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; }

for try in $(seq 1 "$MAXTRY"); do
  echo "[*] boot attempt $try"
  qemu_stop
  qemu_start || { echo "qemu failed to start"; exit 1; }
  sleep 5

  # Wait for Windows to switch into its graphical mode (1024x768).
  gui=0
  for i in $(seq 1 24); do
    sleep 5
    case "$(screen)" in 1024x768*) gui=1; break;; esac
  done
  [ "$gui" = 1 ] || { echo "[!] Windows did not reach graphics mode"; continue; }
  echo "[*] graphics mode reached"

  # Dismiss the Windows-for-Workgroups logon/network prompt.
  sleep 5
  keys ret

  # Wait for Program Manager to finish painting the desktop.
  ok=0
  for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    sleep 5
    set -- $(screen)
    case "$1" in
      1024x768) [ "${2:-0}" -ge 15 ] && { ok=1; break; } ;;
      *) break ;;
    esac
  done
  [ "$ok" = 1 ] || { echo "[!] Program Manager did not come up"; continue; }

  # Minimise + restore Program Manager: forces a full repaint so the whole
  # framebuffer (window titles, icon captions) is up to date for VNC clients.
  keys alt-spc; sleep 2; keys n; sleep 5
  keys alt-spc; sleep 2; keys r; sleep 8

  set -- $(screen /tmp/win311-desktop.png)
  echo "[*] desktop: $1 ${2:-0} colours (screenshot /tmp/win311-desktop.png)"
  if [ "$1" = 1024x768 ] && [ "${2:-0}" -ge 15 ]; then
    echo "[+] Windows 3.11 desktop is up (pid $(cat "$PIDFILE"))"
    exit 0
  fi
done

echo "[!] giving up after $MAXTRY attempts"
exit 1
